scope: Read-only compatibility inspection and options for a future separately authorized pilot; not an executable job configuration or live qualification.

common.version_configuration: Set exact version under AgentConfig.kwargs.version, not a top-level AgentConfig version.
common.skip_install_caveat: BaseInstalledAgent.setup detects the installed version when skip_install is true, but only warns on a mismatch and records the detected version. An independent fail-closed exact-version gate remains required.
common.network: Only the selected inference endpoint should be reachable during execution; setup package downloads must be completed separately. Base URL support does not prove compatibility with the laboratory gateway.
common.retries: Job retry.max_retries defaults to 0 and n_attempts defaults to 1. These do not disable native model/HTTP retries.

codex.compatibility: Native adapter and exact-version option exist; actual Harbor launch with this pin and model is unverified.

suggested_options_for_later_manifest.reasoning_effort: Freeze explicitly or record native default; do not infer parity with Pi/mini.
suggested_options_for_later_manifest.credentials: Names only here. Any real credential use requires a separately authorized run through the harness-owned .env mechanism; never mount host auth.json.

installation.pin_support: npm @openai/codex@<version>; if the requested version already exists, install returns without replacing it.
installation.unfrozen_defaults: Omitted version uses @latest. Fresh glibc installation fetches NVM v0.40.2 and selects floating Node22. Prefer a separately recorded immutable image with the already pinned binary.
installation.nonroot: Runtime uses the environment default agent user; private Codex home is handed to the detected UID/GID, while setup/ownership uses root.

differences_from_lab: Harbor retains native sessions for ATIF; the lab passes --ephemeral.
Harbor does not add the lab --ignore-user-config and --ignore-rules flags. Use an isolated fresh HOME/CODEX_HOME and inspect the task for agent-readable instructions.
Harbor enables unified_exec. Its effective tool configuration and exact 0.155.1 feature acceptance need a separate offline/live qualification gate.
The lab explicitly disables web search and agents. Harbor options/config must freeze these deliberately for this pilot.

Normal native execution resolves OPENAI_API_KEY before CODEX_API_KEY by default and writes temporary auth.json; explicitly choose the intended credential source name. Do not fall back to ChatGPT auth files.
codex.limits: No native turn or USD limit is exposed by this Harbor Codex option set. Outer timeout and operator admission/billing rules are required; they are not an in-flight dollar cap.
accounting: Native session rollouts become ATIF-v1.7; conversion errors are logged and can leave no trajectory, so successful CLI exit alone is insufficient.
Token totals come from rollout token_count events; absent cost is estimated from Harbor host LiteLLM pricing. Treat it as an estimate, not independent billing.
ATIF model_name may originate in configured model_name/turn_context. Do not count it alone as a provider-observed identity.

mini_swe_agent.native_default_agent_class: InteractiveAgent with yolo mode and confirm_exit=false
mini_swe_agent.compatibility: Native adapter and exact-version option exist; CLI flags are present in installed mini2.4.6 source. Existing lab image cannot satisfy Harbor native version detection because uv is absent. Full Harbor launch is unverified.

kwargs.cost_limit.value_from: the separate pilot contract target; native check is post-spend, never a hard USD cap

suggested_options_for_later_manifest.reasoning_effort: Freeze explicitly or record native default; no parity claim.
suggested_options_for_later_manifest.skip_install_precondition: An immutable image with a functioning pinned uv tool installation and independently verified mini/LiteLLM/runtime versions is required first.

installation.unfrozen_defaults: Installer selects Python3.12, downloads uv installer, and adds unpinned litellm[mcp], orjson and fastapi. Mini version alone does not lock the dependency set.

defaults_and_limits: Harbor cost_limit defaults to string 0, disabling cost stopping; packaged mini.yaml step_limit is0. Neither default is acceptable as an implicit pilot budget.
Harbor sets model.model_kwargs.timeout=3600 seconds. A shorter external pilot timeout must be explicit.
mini2.4.6 native retry helper defaults to10 attempts via MSWEA_MODEL_RETRY_STOP_AFTER_ATTEMPT. Preserve and record it, or qualify a deliberately changed value as a distinct condition.
Mini checks accumulated cost before a subsequent query, after a billed call may already exceed the target.
Harbor prepends -c mini before overrides, preserving the packaged prompt; a custom config can set agent.step_limit and model.cost_tracking.
accounting: Harbor sets MSWEA_COST_TRACKING=ignore_errors. Explicit model.cost_tracking=default in a pilot config prevents that from silently replacing the lab cost policy.

Harbor normalizes missing token usage to0 and missing instance_cost to0 in AgentContext. ATIF may instead use null for zero cost and apportions per-step cost by output-token share. Preserve raw native evidence and independently validate completeness; never import these zero fallbacks as observed lab measurements.
ATIF model_name comes from mini info.config.model.model_name. Read raw provider responses for observed identity; ATIF alone is not proof.
Both raw mini-swe-agent.trajectory.json and converted ATIF-v1.7 must exist and reconcile; conversion failures are logged rather than treated as a model failure.

installed_package_inspection.method: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --user1000:1000 --entrypoint python <existing-image>; stdlib importlib.metadata, hashlib and pathlib only; no host mounts, forwarded credentials, API client imports or model execution.
